sentences.text: Nyx, a 7-year-old female Domestic Shorthair, neuter status not recorded, has a live flag for possible foreign material: the AI photo read of the May 23 vomit noted a possible plastic fragment, unconfirmed, and the photo was not retained.
Vomiting is also flagged on 4 of the 7 days to Jun 30 and over at least 47 days, with 23 entries on 23 of 43 logged days from May 14, her first entry of any kind, so onset is unknown.

She is free-fed Nature's Variety Duck and Royal Canin Weight Care (lists chicken), intake not directly observed, alongside at least 20 Temptations Chicken treat feedings, and no food could be isolated.
The record is logged on 43 of 90 days, 4 of the first 45 and 39 of the last 45, with nothing logged Jul 1 to 2.
